Eventually, we may forget where the performance ends and our true selves begin. But truth has a way of resurfacing. It emerges in unexpected conversations, in broken promises, in moments of loss, and in the quiet hours when distractions no longer work. It asks questions we have spent years avoiding. Why did we stay when we knew we should leave? Why did we forgive what we never truly healed from? Why did we sacrifice our peace to preserve relationships that were slowly taking it away?
